description: This file defines the 'Marketplace' controller class within the Opencart admin module. It handles various marketplace functionalities such as listing extensions, viewing extension details, handling purchases, downloads, comments, and replies through API calls, curl requests, and rendering views with data. The class interacts with configuration, session, URL, language, and other core components, indicating it is a central piece for marketplace management in the Opencart admin backend.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the marketplace functionalities within the Opencart admin panel. Implements methods for listing extensions, viewing extension details, handling purchase processes, downloading extensions, managing comments and replies, and interacting with external API services via curl requests.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the marketplace interface, setting up filters, breadcrumbs, categories, licenses, sorts, and rendering the marketplace view with data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method to load and display the list of marketplace extensions, delegating to 'getList'.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches a list of extensions from an external API, with filtering, sorting, and pagination support, and returns a view rendering the list.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific extension from the external API and displays it, including images, description, ratings, and download options.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Provides download, install, uninstall, and delete options for extension files, based on session data.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Handles purchasing an extension, sending secure API requests, updating session data on success.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads an extension package file from external API, saves it locally, and registers the install.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Submits a new comment for an extension via API, with signature verification.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Fetches and displays comments for an extension, supporting pagination.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Fetches and displays reply comments for a specific comment, supporting pagination.
